units.source_text: 眼看进入收官阶段，棋手的紧张状态同布局或中盘时也不尽相同。

en.t: As the game was plainly entering its final stage, the player's tension was not quite the same as it had been during the opening or the middle game.

units.source_text: 神经也过敏了，探出身子的姿态也更增添了可怕的色彩。

en.t: His nerves had grown hypersensitive as well, and the way he leaned forward made the scene seem even more frightening.

units.source_text: 恍如尖利的短刀在交锋，呼吸急促起来。

en.t: It was as if sharp daggers were crossing blades, and his breathing grew hurried.

units.source_text: 简直是智慧的火花在闪烁。

en.t: It was truly like sparks of intelligence flashing in the air.
